title: Soft White Sandwich Loaf
summary: A bread-flour dough enriched with milk, butter and a little honey is kneaded until springy, risen, rolled tightly into a tin and baked until golden, giving a soft, even crumb that keeps well.
equipment: stand mixer with dough hook (or large bowl)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine the dry ingredients, add the warm milk mixture and mix until no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Knead
steps.text: Knead until smooth, springy and able to stretch thin.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Roll the dough tightly into a log and prove in the buttered tin until domed above the rim.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Mist and bake until deep golden and 88-93 °C in the centre.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Turn out and cool fully before slicing.

tips: Rolling the dough up tightly gives an even crumb without big holes.
Check the centre with a thermometer; a golden crust alone can hide a damp middle.
Slice with a serrated bread knife once completely cool.
storage: Keep the cooled loaf in a bread bag at room temperature for up to 3 days. Slice and freeze for up to 1 month, then toast straight from frozen. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
